place_info.title: Micklethwait Barbecue
place_info.address: 4602 Tanney St, Austin, TX 78721, United States

reviews.snippet:
This is our default for BBQ in Austin! The environment is relaxing and while it’s busy at times, it’s never wait an hour or two in the beating sun to order.

We have visited several times and tried a variety of meat and sides. It’s all been great! Our favorites include the brisket, beef rib, sausage and turkey. This past visit I personally got the brisket sandwich and the bun was just perfect. The sides are amazing as well-I’m not even a mac and cheese lover but it’s so good here! The citrus beets are another one you can’t skip-so light and refreshing.

We love eating outdoors here, my only recommendation would be some fly fans to make sure they stay off food. Definitely worth a visit!

reviews.snippet: Great barbecue. The brisket was fantastic. The pastrami was excellent. The ribs were great. Interesting sides: String beans, cabbage, and potato salad were all tasty.  Friendly staff and ample outdoor seating. The flies were a nuisance but it’s hard to blame them. Obviously Texas flies know good BBQ when they see it.

reviews.snippet: Reddit told me to come here - glad we listened. We got two plates so we can try a variety of meats and sides. We had the brisket, turkey, spare ribs and the Czech sausage. For sides we had Mac and cheese, braised cabbage, beets, and potato salad. Great meat. Standout meat was the spare rib. The turkey was a little too salty for our liking. The braised cabbage was also a standout side. Would come back if visiting Austin. Nice that they also have indoor and outdoor seating. We didn't have a wait.

reviews.snippet:
We came to Micklethwait from multiple friends' recommendations during our week-long trip San Antonio to Austin. It was fantastic!

For 2 people, we ordered the brisket, pork ribs, cheesy hot link, with mac n cheese and green beans sides. I normally don't prefer dry rub ribs, but they were amazing, so flavorful. The green beans were also perfect and a great tangy compliment to the meats. We were really impressed by the cheesy hot link - it was staff-recommended since they're known for their sausages.

We came in around noon on a Friday, and we waited a bit to order but not long - and the food is prepared immediately. Staff were so friendly, helpful and welcoming - we would definitely return for the service (and the food).

The indoor and outdoor seating areas are both really nice - great space for groups. Parking was also not hard to find on their street.

The flavors of Micklethwait were really unforgettable, and we hope to return soon!

reviews.snippet:
Micklethwait Barbecue was absolutely amazing for our wedding catering! Everything was so delicious, and so many of our guests complimented the food all night long. The mac and cheese was awesome and all of the meats were incredibly flavorful, juicy, and cooked perfectly. We had the brisket, ribs, and turkey, and my goodness… they were SO good!

Their communication throughout the process was great, and the buffet setup/service ran very smoothly on the wedding day, which made everything so easy. They do provide utensils, plates, silverware, and napkins, which is super convenient, ( includes in the cost) but we chose to bring our own for a more elevated look.

We also did a tasting beforehand, which I highly recommend, they made it easy to know this was the place for us. We had tried other caterers before, but nothing compared to Micklethwait.

For our wedding of about 46 guests, we chose the 3 meat and 4 sides option. The total came out to roughly $2,600, ( I think $43 person roughly. It is cheaper if you select 3 meats. 3 sides option) which included tax, a travel fee since we were outside their normal radius, and tip. We even tipped a little extra above the service amount because we truly felt the quality and experience were worth it.

Even though this was a little above our original budget, spending a bit more on the food was absolutely worth it. I would absolutely recommend them for any large gathering, event, or wedding like ours. Delicious food, smooth service, and a great team to work with!
